The six countries below existed before the rule and state none for the tools of the shared sets: stating one means somebody reads the instrument's terms, and no machine may write "free" on a guess. THIS LIST CAN ONLY SHRINK: lib/ulke/ulkeyeOzel.paket.test.ts fails when a country that is not on it leaves a licence out, and when a country that is on it has stated them all (take it off the list then). A tool only one country has, and a link-out tile, state their licence in every pack, listed here or not. Tests read this file; no application code and no pack does.
